import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Clean and prepare data
df = df.dropna(subset=['Rasse1Text'])
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
df_top = df[df['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.countplot(data=df_top, x='Rasse1Text', order=top_breeds, palette='viridis')
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Top 10 Most Registered Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
